definition.index: per-persona LDA centroid built from the persona's OTHER shoots
definition.query: per-image LDA from the held-out shoot, L2-normalized
definition.leakage: none — no query contributes to its own centroid

units: LDA 64-d, L2-normalized (norm 1.0); on-disk per-image vectors are raw coords ~153
caveat: centroids use at most --support per-image vectors per persona, so they are noisier than the full corpus centroids; this makes the ceiling a slight LOWER bound on the true value.
